'''HELIOS-3D's droid army''' was a short-lived rogue [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] established by [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Consisting of various battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], the army [[Mission to the Thicket|battled]] a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force in the [[Thicket]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], where it was mostly exterminated.
